messages.content: I said something I regret to my best friend.
That happens to everyone eventually. Do you want to talk through what you said, or focus on what to do next?
What to do next I think, I already feel bad enough about it.

Fair. A direct apology usually lands better than a vague one — naming specifically what you said and why it was wrong, rather than a general 'sorry if I upset you.' Have you reached out yet, or is this still fresh?
